title: Training Note: First-Extension Reduction on the Kestrel New Vehicle Retail Extension Fee
content:
**Training note, Kestrel New Vehicle Retail Installment Sale Contract.**

**Rule.** When the contract's ledger shows no extension and no due-date change, 3.00 dollars are taken off the extension fee; when it shows no extension but at least one due-date change, 1.50 dollars are taken off; in every other case nothing is taken off.

The ledger is read over the whole life of the contract, before the extension now being granted is booked. The dollars come off the extension fee as figured for the contract from the tier's extension fee, and the fee is never below zero.

| Extension entries on the ledger | Due-date change entries on the ledger | Taken off |
|---|---|---|
| none | none | 3.00 dollars |
| none | one or more | 1.50 dollars |
| one or more | any | nothing |

## Basis Q&A

**Does a due-date change made years ago still count?** Yes: any due-date change entry on the ledger counts, so a contract never extended but with one old due-date change has 1.50 dollars taken off.

**A second extension on the same contract?** The ledger already shows an extension, so nothing is taken off.
